operator: Transpratur (Transpratur Transportes Coletivos e Turísticos) — member of Consórcio TransOeste
notes:
Bus-only operator (no metro/rail in Divinópolis). Operator confirmed as TRANSPRATUR on trancid.com.br (itinerario.php / linhasehorarios.php line list: "TRANSPRATUR - LINHA 61 - CENTRAL ABC / SANTA CRUZ (POSTO COELHO)" and "TRANSPRATUR - LINHA 62 - CENTRAL ABC / JARDIM PRIMAVERA"), Consórcio TransOeste. The trancid.com.br schedule/itinerary detail is rendered client-side and could not be scraped statically (the site's Google MyMaps embed covers only line 45/Trancid, not 61/62), so ordered stop lists + service spans come from Moovit's per-line offline PDFs (appassets.mvtdev.com/map/131/l/5097/651572.pdf for L61, 651573.pdf for L62), corroborated by onibus.online/horariodeonibus. 

Stops: ordered stop lists taken verbatim from Moovit for the 4 headline directions — L61 Santa Cruz→Central ABC (61 stops) and Central ABC→Santa Cruz (53), L62 Jd. Primavera→Central ABC and Central ABC→Jd. Primavera. 100 unique stops emitted (down-sampled slightly from the raw ~61-stop lists to representative points). Coordinates: geocoded via OSM Nominatim (WGS-84) at street level for ~93 stops; ~7 small local streets in Santo Antônio dos Campos / Santa Cruz / Jardim Primavera that Nominatim lacks (Rua João Martins Coelho, José Bernardino de Sena, Catarina Nascimento de Castro, José João Oliveira, José Martinho de Oliveira, Isauro Belarmino Filho) were anchored to their known neighborhood cluster confirmed by Moovit stop ordering — approximate but in the correct district. Stops sharing a street are spread ~35 m apart by house number so they are not stacked.

Trips: L61 and L62 each have many Moovit "sentidos" (8 and 15 respectively via Posto Coelho / Tamboril / Areião / Santa Cruz variants); this feed models the two principal directions of each line as representative round trips at an even 30-min headway across the published weekday operating span (L61 05:00–22:15 out / 05:56–21:17 return; L62 06:00–20:24 out / 06:52–18:14 return). Interior stop times are interpolated evenly across Moovit's stated end-to-end run time (54 min L61, 57 min L62). Calendar = weekday (Mon–Fri) only; Moovit shows Sat/Sun operate on reduced spans but those were not modeled as separate services.

Full GTFS written to /home/ubuntu/adresses/gtfs_transpratur/ and /home/ubuntu/adresses/gtfs_transpratur.zip (agency, stops[100], routes[2], trips[118], stop_times[4929], calendar[1]); validated for referential integrity and monotonic stop times. The structured output below carries all 100 stops, both routes, the calendar, and one representative full trip per direction (4 trips, 165 stop_times) rather than all 118 generated trips.

Confidence 0.62: stop lists, endpoints and operating spans are well-evidenced from Moovit; interior clock times are synthetic (even headway/interpolation), several minor-street coordinates are neighborhood-approximated, and the many minor route variants (Posto Coelho/Tamboril/Areião) are not enumerated.
